answer: Unrepeatable answer challenge. Each agent identity must solve a fresh challenge whose verified answer is derived from a private kernel held only by that agent; the kernel is never transmitted, only a commitment. Answers are single-use: the network records each answer's pearl hash and rejects duplicates, so copying a solution fails. Solving costs the attacker one distinct secret and one full derivation per identity, making a thousand identities cost a thousand independent computations, each with its own hardware time and timber spent on sustained compute.
